notes.title: PATCH V.1.4.021
notes.content:
[p][b]Hi![/b][/p][p]Some players have reported strange bugs related to framerate issues. The engine that [i]DHCB[/i] was built on is framerate-dependent, and the game is not intended to be played on monitors with refresh rates higher than 60 Hz. As the warning message states when the game starts, using higher refresh rates may cause bugs.[/p][p]Today, I tested a different workaround for this issue, but there's no guarantee it will work. If you're playing on a 144 Hz monitor and everything is running smoothly without any errors, please let us know![/p][p]Have a great weekend.[/p][p]Sincerely,
[b]BC[/b][/p]

notes.title: THE BIGGEST UPDATE EVER: Part 5 conclusion + more
Custom Window skins
notes.content:
Hi!

Some players reported chromophobia from the standard purple cyberpunk colors of the dialog windows in our game. We now added an option in the menu allowing you to change between several window styles to match your taste. They are based on the FF series, Chrono Trigger, Earthbound, and Undertale. 

We also now have special ammo for  handguns, shotguns, and rifles that will trigger different vulnerabilities of the animals and robots:

[list]
[*]Incendiary ammo;
[*]Freezing ammo;
[*]Electric ammo;
[/list]

Aline updated several sprites of the game. The enanthiornitine birds, the raptor, and the Tupandactylus now look gorgeous!!!

She is also working very closely with me in the polishing phase. We are getting so close to 90% completion.

We expect to conclude the game before May!

If you are enjoying the experience so far, would you please review the game on the Steam Store page? This would help us gain more visibility and may accelerate the final production phase.

If you want to read about Dino Hazard projects, like the comic book, figures, books, etc:

Our wiki: https://dinohazard.fandom.com/wiki/Special:AllPages

Our Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dino.hazard/
Our Twitter: @_DinoHazard
Our YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/colecionadoresdeossos

Really anxious to conclude Part 5 chapter next week. It is the most extensive chapter of the history. Part 6 will be shorter and SHOCKING!

Jurassic greetings,
BoneCollectors.

notes.title: HUGE UPDATE: OVER 150 NEW ANIMALS
notes.content:
Good afternoon dear players!

I'm sorry for the delay. A lot happened this month. health issues, surgery, research symposium, and much more. But here I come with the biggest update this game ever had!!!

I've been working hard with artists Felipe, Saulo, and Will to finish every animal that was still missing in the game. [i]Ilha Grande[/i] will now look more alive than ever since now we finally have insects, lizards, frogs, turtles, and many new different organisms now wandering around the landscapes.

This is what I've working on:

Tutorials:
[list]
[*]There are now 3 short tutorials to introduce the depth of gameplay in battles;
[/list]

Map improvements:
[list]
[*]Several new wildlife NPCs;
[*]There are now signs showing which SAFARI ZONE the play is located in. Hopefully, this will help players find their missing animals in DinoDEX;
[/list]

System improvements:
[list]
[*]Battle interface now has icons to help players in action;
[*]Victory scene now shows how many LOVE and HATE points the player obtained during battles;
[*]Improvements in Russian language (thanks, Diana!);
[*]Many bugfixes;
[/list]

BIG UPDATE: Part 4 + Part 5 + Open World beta
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I sincerely hope you are all doing as great as possible during this period.

There are several excellent news!

I finally bring you PART 4, PART 5, and the open-world beta experience. It took me several months of work but I am really proud of it now. I hope you also appreciate it.

The game system has also substantially improved. You will notice it. 

However, there is a negative consequence: every save file prior to this update is now obsolete. You will need to restart a new game in order to check this new version of [i]Dino Hazard[/i].

I am really sorry if you lost precious data. I tried to look for a way around it and created a hidden cheat for players that want to jump straight to the new levels. I strongly recommend playing a full new game but if you want to use this cheat follow the instructions bellow:

Start a fresh new game and go to SECTOR B10. Look for that tree fern by the shore up north. Just interact with it. This will allow you to jump to the following chapter of your choice.

[url=https://postimg.cc/6yfb6GTT][img]https://i.postimg.cc/6yfb6GTT/Game-Nrb-KRCYVXs.png[/img][/url]

In these past months we also released the Dino Hazard Comic book! Yes! It was published by Dinoleta in partnership with BoneCollectors. The trailer is awesome! You can check it in Portuguese with English subtitles bellow:

notes.title: Update: bug fixes, new localization, comics, and collectible figures
notes.content:
Good afternoon everyone!

I hope you had a nice turn of the year and that you are doing alright during the pandemic.

Today I bring you a small update with some minor text fixes in English. Many thanks to Diana Kurilovich for pointing those out. I also fixed the diagonal moment speed. What do you think now? Feel free to give me feedback down below.

I am also sorry for the late delay since last December. It is for a good reason. I am implementing the Spanish localization script into the game. I was also working with two scientific papers during this period. Those manuscripts are about to be submitted and then I will come back to Dino Hazard full time.

Our pixel artists Will and Daniel had also provided dozens of new NPCs for the upcoming parts 4 and 5. 

I won't deny it. I am really anxious to present to you what is about to come next.

Thank you for your patience.

Regarding the Comics project, Marcio Castro is coloring Part 1 and soon he will start posting some neat prints! 

Regarding our collectible figures, Hugo Cafasso told me the Irritators had already shipped from China! We will bring great news real soon!

We have new battle mechanics:

[list]
[*][b]Adaptive turns[/b]: Party order will change in real-time according to players' changes.
[*][b]Turn order display[/b]: Now you can preview the player order prior to planning your strategies.
[*][b]Break Shield[/b]: Opponents now present a shield system. If you break the shields they reach the Vulnerable state.
[*][b]Weakness Display[/b]: Every opponent now has several icons revealing their weaknesses. If you hit an enemy with one of their weaknesses, you will deal extra damage.
[/list]

We are also pleased to announce a new skill for battles:

[list]
[*][b]Reveal I - skill[/b]: This is a new Ranger skill. It reveals the enemy's weakness. One by one.
[/list]

We are also pleased to announce new equipment:

[list]
[*][b]Binoculars - equip[/b]: This is a new accessory. It reveals the enemy's weakness. One by one.
[/list]
